visual_base.visual_narrative_log:
(1) A man with styled brown hair, wearing a white New Balance t-shirt and burgundy shorts, stands on an indoor tennis court with a blue surface and green border. He throws a yellow tennis ball high into the air and swings a black and green racket to serve. The court is lit by bright overhead industrial lights, and a high net hangs in the background.
(2) The camera follows the man as he moves dynamically across the blue court, hitting forehands and backhands. He is wearing white wristbands and white socks with black and white tennis shoes. The background shows brick walls and windows typical of an indoor athletic facility, with a few red stools placed near the sidelines.
(3) The man walks along a white-walled building at night, holding a black bag and wearing a blue and white striped towel over his shoulders. He gestures with his right hand as he talks directly into the camera lens. Passers-by are visible in the background under bright exterior lights, with bicycles parked near a glass-fronted entrance.
(4) Back inside the court, the man stands near the net, holding his racket and a tennis ball. He points his finger and demonstrates serving techniques, his face showing focus and later a smile. A close-up reveals the broken blue strings of a silver tennis racket held by another person in a white shirt.
(5) Two women, one in a white t-shirt and black leggings and another in a white tank top and tan pants, attempt to hit tennis balls. They are shown in medium shots, swinging rackets with varying degrees of success. The man is seen dodging balls that fly toward him, laughing with wide expressions.
(6) A group of four people—the main man, another man in a white ASICS shirt, and the two women—stand close together, facing the camera for a final address. They are all smiling and gesturing, with the tennis court net and a red brick wall forming the background environment.
